subject: world_language
concept: Writing a short connected text (a simple letter, journal entry, or description) on a familiar topic
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR B1 'write simple connected texts' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans their piece using a simple beginning/middle/end organizer in the target language
exercise.abstract: Student writes a short connected paragraph on a familiar topic in the target language

assessment.mastery_threshold: paragraph is coherent, uses connecting words, and stays on topic
misconception_flags: writes a list of disconnected sentences rather than a connected paragraph

interest_binding: topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
